menu_items.title: Truffle Double Smash
menu_items.description: Double Angus beef patties, Swiss truffle cheese, caramelized onions, garlic truffle aioli on a toasted brioche bun.

menu_items.title: Crispy Nashville Hot Chicken
menu_items.description: Buttermilk fried chicken breast drenched in Nashville spice oil, comeback slaw, dill pickles on brioche.

menu_items.title: Cajun Loaded Fries
menu_items.description: Crisp skin-on rustic fries dusted in Louisiana Cajun seasoning, melted cheddar cheese, and smoky dip.

menu_items.title: Artisan Vanilla Bean Shake
menu_items.description: Hand-spun Madagascan vanilla bean ice cream with whole milk and whipped cream.

menu_items.title: Super Smash Duo Combo
menu_items.description: 2x Truffle Double Smash Burgers, 1x Cajun Loaded Fries, and 2x Soft Drinks.

menu_items.title: Wood-Fired Truffle Funghi Pizza
menu_items.description: Wild forest portobello mushrooms, fresh Fior di Latte mozzarella, white truffle oil, and roasted garlic over 48h cold-fermented sourdough crust.

menu_items.title: Smoked Pepperoni & Hot Honey Pizza
menu_items.description: Crispy beef pepperoni cups, San Marzano tomato pomodoro, torn basil, finished with a generous drizzle of house spicy red chili hot honey.

menu_items.title: Creamy Fettuccine Alfredo with Charred Chicken
menu_items.description: Fresh egg fettuccine ribbons tossed in 24-month aged Reggiano parmesan cream reduction, topped with rosemary grilled chicken breast.

menu_items.title: Stuffed Cheesy Garlic Dough Knots
menu_items.description: Six hand-tied sourdough knots smothered in garlic butter, fresh parsley, stuffed with melted mozzarella, served with warm San Marzano marinara dip.

menu_items.title: Traditional Classic Tiramisu Della Nonna
menu_items.description: Authentic Savoiardi ladyfingers steeped in rich dark espresso, layered with airy mascarpone zabaglione and dusted with Valrhona cocoa.

menu_items.title: Desi Mutton Shinwari Karahi
menu_items.description: Tender mountain mutton cooked in natural lamb fat with only vine-ripened tomatoes, salt, green chilies, and ginger slivers. Authentic tribal recipe.

menu_items.title: Chicken White Makhni Handi
menu_items.description: Boneless tender chicken cubes braised in thick clotted dairy cream, butter, black pepper, and ground cashews in a clay handi.

menu_items.title: Peshawari Chapli Kebab Platter (2 Pcs)
menu_items.description: Authentic handmade beef chapli kebabs spiced with anardana, coriander seeds, crushed red pepper, and fried tomato slices.

menu_items.title: Charcoal Malai Boti Skewers (8 Pcs)
menu_items.description: Boneless chicken cubes soaked in fresh malai, green chilies, and white pepper, char-grilled over glowing coals until juicy and smoky.

menu_items.title: Sesame Roghani Naan Basket (3 Pcs)
menu_items.description: Three warm tandoor-fired soft roghani naans brushed generously with pure desi ghee and toasted white sesame seeds.

menu_items.title: Citrus Quinoa & Grilled Salmon Bowl
menu_items.description: Pan-seared Atlantic salmon fillet over organic tri-color quinoa, Hass avocado, edamame beans, and roasted sesame-ginger vinaigrette.

menu_items.title: Amazonian Wild Acai Energy Bowl
menu_items.description: Pure organic Brazilian acai purée blended with frozen wild berries and banana, topped with almond butter drizzle, chia seeds, and artisan granola.

menu_items.title: Smoked Turkey Breast & Brie Panini
menu_items.description: Shaved hickory-smoked turkey breast, melted double-cream French brie, sweet fig jam, and wild baby arugula pressed crispy in rustic sourdough.

menu_items.title: Mediterranean Herb Falafel & Beet Hummus Bowl
menu_items.description: Crispy herb chickpea falafels over vibrant roasted beetroot hummus, pickled red onions, Kalamata olives, cherry tomatoes, with warm zaatar pita.

menu_items.title: Vanilla Iced Spanish Latte (Double Shot)
menu_items.description: Double shot of 100% Arabica single-origin espresso poured over condensed sweet milk, fresh whole milk, and crushed crystal ice.

menu_items.title: Spicy Salmon Crunch Roll (8 Pcs)
menu_items.description: Fresh Norwegian salmon, cucumber, sriracha aioli, rolled in toasted nori, topped with tempura flakes and unagi glaze.

menu_items.title: Rich Tonkotsu Chashu Ramen
menu_items.description: 16-hour slow-simmered rich savory broth, hand-pulled ramen noodles, tender torched chashu, ajitsuke tamago egg, and nori.

menu_items.title: Golden Crispy Prawn Tempura (5 Pcs)
menu_items.description: Jumbo tiger prawns coated in airy Japanese panko batter, fried golden, served with house tentsuyu dipping broth.

menu_items.title: Pan-Seared Chicken Gyoza Dumplings (6 Pcs)
menu_items.description: Crispy-bottom steamed dumplings filled with seasoned minced chicken, scallions, ginger, and sesame ponzu glaze.

menu_items.title: California Deluxe King Crab Roll
menu_items.description: King crab blend, Hass avocado, Japanese mayo, and crisp cucumber coated with bright orange tobiko caviar.

menu_items.title: Shahi Chicken Makhni Handi
menu_items.description: Boneless tender chicken simmered in clay handi with rich cashew nut gravy, fresh cream, butter, and fenugreek leaves.

menu_items.title: Dum Pukht Chicken Biryani (Special)
menu_items.description: Aromatic long-grain basmati rice layered with saffron chicken pieces, golden fried onions, prunes, and mint leaves.

menu_items.title: Dal Makhni Shahi Slow-Cooked
menu_items.description: Black lentils slow cooked overnight on charcoal with butter, cream, and fragrant Kashmiri spices.

menu_items.title: Garlic Butter Roghani Naan
menu_items.description: Fluffy clay oven baked naan brushed with melted country butter, minced roasted garlic, and toasted sesame seeds.

menu_items.title: Shahi Zafrani Kheer Matka
menu_items.description: Traditional slow-reduced milk rice pudding scented with saffron, cardamom, crushed pistachios, and almonds.

menu_items.title: Slow-Cooked Birria Beef Tacos (3 Pcs)
menu_items.description: Tender shredded spiced beef in crispy griddled corn tortillas with melted Oaxaca cheese, cilantro, and rich savory dipping consommé.

menu_items.title: Chipotle Chicken Fajita Quesadilla
menu_items.description: Large toasted flour tortilla packed with grilled chipotle chicken, sautéed peppers, caramelized onions, and Monterey Jack cheese.

menu_items.title: Loaded Fiesta Nachos Supreme
menu_items.description: Crisp hand-cut tortilla chips piled high with warm queso, black beans, pico de gallo, pickled jalapeños, and sour cream.

menu_items.title: Cali Carne Asada Burrito Grande
menu_items.description: Grilled flank steak, seasoned rustic fries, house guacamole, cheddar cheese, and salsa verde wrapped in a warm 12-inch tortilla.

menu_items.title: Cinnamon Sugar Churros with Chocolate Dip
menu_items.description: Four crispy Spanish churros rolled in Saigon cinnamon sugar, served with warm Belgian dark chocolate dipping sauce.

menu_items.title: Belgian Dark Chocolate & Strawberry Waffle
menu_items.description: Golden Belgian waffle smothered in melted Belgian milk and dark chocolate, fresh seasonal strawberries, and vanilla gelato scoop.

menu_items.title: San Sebastian Burnt Basque Cheesecake
menu_items.description: Velvety caramelized Basque cheesecake with a gooey creamy center, paired with warm poured Belgian milk chocolate.

menu_items.title: Sicilian Pistachio Artisanal Gelato (Double Scoop)
menu_items.description: Authentic slow-churned Italian gelato crafted with 100% roasted Sicilian Bronte pistachios and whole dairy cream.

menu_items.title: Lotus Biscoff Crumble French Crepe
menu_items.description: Warm delicate crepe filled and topped with warm Lotus Biscoff spread, crushed spiced caramelized biscuits, and cream.

menu_items.title: Molten Belgian Fudge Lava Cake
menu_items.description: Decadent warm chocolate cake with a molten flowing dark fudge core, dusted with powdered sugar.

menu_items.title: Signature Karak Matka Chai
menu_items.description: Brewed strong in clay pot over coal, boiled with whole buffalo milk, green cardamom, and caramelized unrefined jaggery.

menu_items.title: Chicken Malai Boti Cheese Paratha
menu_items.description: Crisp flaky multi-layered paratha stuffed with tender charred chicken malai boti chunks and melted stretchy mozzarella cheese.

menu_items.title: Classic Karachi Daal Anda Bun Kabab
menu_items.description: Toasted soft bun with spiced lentil patty dipped in whipped egg foam, spicy green chutney, onions, and sweet tamarind dip.

menu_items.title: Nutella Stuffed Sweet Crispy Paratha
menu_items.description: Golden crispy flaky paratha oozing with warm melted Nutella hazelnut chocolate inside and powdered sugar dusting.

menu_items.title: Elaichi Doodh Patti Chai (Thermos Serve)
menu_items.description: Aromatic tea leaves slow-cooked strictly in pure whole milk with crushed green cardamom pods.

menu_items.title: Smokehouse BBQ Chicken Pizza
menu_items.description: Stone-baked thin crust, smoked chicken chunks, sweet hickory BBQ swirl, red onions, and melted fresh mozzarella.

menu_items.title: Four Cheese Truffle White Pizza
menu_items.description: White garlic cream base, fresh mozzarella, gorgonzola, aged parmesan, ricotta dollops, and Italian white truffle oil.

menu_items.title: Crispy Buffalo Wings with Blue Cheese
menu_items.description: Eight jumbo crispy fried wings tossed in tangy cayenne pepper buffalo sauce, served with celery and creamy blue cheese dip.

menu_items.title: Stuffed Pepperoni Calzone Supreme
menu_items.description: Folded pizza pocket stuffed with Italian pepperoni, ricotta, mozzarella, and herbs, baked in brick oven.

menu_items.title: Warm Skillet Chocolate Cookie Pie
menu_items.description: Freshly baked warm chocolate chip cookie served in a cast-iron skillet, topped with cold Madagascar vanilla ice cream.

menu_items.title: Lyallpur Special Mutton Chops (6 Pcs)
menu_items.description: Juicy rib-eye mutton chops marinated in roasted cumin, papaya, and Peshawari spices, char-grilled over live coals.

menu_items.title: Jinnah Colony Smoky Chicken Tikka Karahi
menu_items.description: Charcoal-grilled chicken tikka pieces wok-tossed in pure desi ghee with fresh vine tomatoes, green chilies, and ginger.

menu_items.title: Charcoal Beef Seekh Kebab Platter (4 Pcs)
menu_items.description: Hand-minced tender beef skewers seasoned with fresh coriander, green chilies, and garam masala, served with mint chutney.

menu_items.title: Royal Zafrani Chicken Dum Biryani
menu_items.description: Long-grain aged basmati rice steamed with spiced chicken, saffron essence, caramelized onions, and mint raita.

menu_items.title: Desi Ghee Garlic Roghani Naan Basket
menu_items.description: Three clay-oven baked fluffy roghani naans brushed with melted desi ghee, roasted garlic, and white sesame seeds.

menu_items.title: Double Cheese Crown Crust Pizza (Large)
menu_items.description: Signature crown crust stuffed with chicken seekh kebab bites and cream cheese, topped with grilled chicken and mozzarella.

menu_items.title: Faisalabad Crunch Zinger & Cheese Burger
menu_items.description: Crispy golden buttermilk fried chicken thigh, cheddar cheese slice, spicy dynamite sauce, and iceberg lettuce on brioche.

menu_items.title: Smoky Jalapeño Double Beef Smash Burger
menu_items.description: Two seared crusted Angus beef patties, double American cheese, pickled jalapeños, and smoky chipotle mayo.

menu_items.title: Loaded Peri-Peri Chicken Fries
menu_items.description: Crispy crinkle-cut fries topped with flame-grilled peri-peri chicken strips, warm nacho cheese sauce, and jalapeños.

menu_items.title: Belgian Chocolate Fudge Oreo Shake
menu_items.description: Thick hand-spun chocolate fudge ice cream blended with crushed Oreo cookies, fresh milk, and whipped cream.
